findings.detail: FR-002's Performance boundary condition ('Buyer search/discovery response time — TBD — needs stakeholder input') from nfr_spec_output is missing from generator_output's FR-002.nfrs — only the Usability row survived. Added the restored TBD to open_questions and corrected prd.md's FR-002 NFR table and Open Questions section to match.
